'''Ishale Meahonon''' was a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] serving under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Pilia Tonth]] aboard the [[Far*Reach IV PQR]] ''[[Wanderer]]'' when it crashed on [[Isis/Legends|Isis]].

==Biography==
Meahonon chose to serve in the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] as it allowed her to see the stars without being bossed around.

==Personality and traits==
Meahonon would kill anyone she considered a threat. Although not paranoid, it is noted that Meahonon had few friends. Her incredible physical and mental stamina was something greatly regarded by her fellows.

Meahonon was a tall woman, with long red hair reaching down to the small of her back, which she wore in a braid often tucked into the back of her coat.

==Appearances==
*''[[The Isis Coordinates]]'' {{1st}}
